title: 1 m ground height fields per patch

frame.description: Course frame of scripts/layline-bake-venue.mjs: ENU metres about the venue origin, rotated so +y runs up the course axis. 1 unit = 1 m.
frame.verticalNote: z is the source file's own elevation, orthometric metres, unshifted.

method: Minimum z of classes 2 and 20 per 1 m cell, then hole-filled by repeated 4-neighbour averaging. `observed` marks the cells that hold a real return; everything else in `ground` is interpolated and can travel at most fillPasses cells from an observation. Replaces the z11 Terrarium guess inside these boxes, which is 64 m per sample and reads Island Grissom's 4.9 m deck at a 23 m mean.

encoding.ground: int16 little-endian centimetres, row-major from (x0, y0) with +x fastest, gzip then base64
encoding.observed: one bit per cell, LSB first within each byte, same order, gzip then base64
encoding.note: dataSha256 is over the uncompressed bytes, so it is independent of the zlib build that packed them.

inputs.note: Every raw file behind these numbers is listed with its sha256, URL and retrieval date in provenance.json. The digests here pin the exact sets this product read: listSha256 is sha256 over the sorted `<sha256>\t<file>` lines.
